verdict.rationale: Smooth documents programmatic session and task management through REST endpoints: creating persistent browser sessions, listing tasks, cancelling tasks, and sending session actions such as close. However, nothing in the evidence documents running many sessions concurrently or publishes concurrency limits; the session docs describe sequential tasks within a single browser instance. missing for 10: documented concurrent/parallel session support, published concurrency limits or quotas, fleet-scale orchestration evidence, independent corroboration.
